response.justification: Bogdan is a highly capable Staff Software Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in distributed systems and recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure. However, he lacks the executive leadership experience required for a Chief Technology Officer role at a scale-up. There is no evidence on his resume of scaling engineering teams, managing managers, or designing complex, regulated fintech risk systems, making him fundamentally misaligned with the core requirements of this executive position.
strengths: Extensive hands-on engineering experience across distributed systems, microservices, and high-throughput environments.
Recent practical exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling.
Strong software craftsmanship mindset with deep expertise in TDD, CI/CD, and open-source platform development.
concerns: Complete lack of executive leadership experience, having exclusively held Individual Contributor roles.
No demonstrated track record of scaling engineering organizations or developing a senior technical leadership layer.
Lacks deep architectural experience in high-stakes fintech infrastructure, such as real-time credit-risk assessment.
